data.name: Nageena
data.gender_notes: Nageena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Nageena is derived from the word ‘najjan’, which means jasmine. Jasmine flowers are known for their sweet fragrance and are often used as symbols of beauty and elegance in Islamic culture. The name Nageena holds a spiritual significance as well, as jasmine is believed to represent purity and devotion. The name Nageena carries the meaning “Jasmine flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nageena usually hope their child will grow to embody jasmine flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nageena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jasmine flower.”
